description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 te kompleksi Grand, prane tregut elektrik.
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 2 te nje pallati 9 kate i mire administruar me ashensor.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe bruto 73m2 dhe ajo e shkelur 64m2.
Disponon Soxhorno, dhoma e gjumit, garderobe, depo tualet te bollshem.
Eshte mundesia per ta modifikuar ne 2+1 te vogel.
Me hipoteke
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the Grand complex, near the electrical market. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a 9-story building, well managed with an elevator. The apartment has a gross surface of 73m2 and a floor area of ​​64m2. It has a Soxhorno, bedroom, wardrobe, ample toilet storage. It is possible to modify it into a small 2+1. With mortgage
